headline: Gameweek 11 transfer talk is everywhere, but you only need one short weekly decision window and a safe, simple plan.

points.text: Most of this material is video content from one FPL creator, and several videos carry paid ad links. Treat their advice as one person's view.
points.label: reported

points.text: The creator is weighing whether to sell Haaland and whether to keep or sell Man United attackers. Both are open questions, not settled advice.
points.label: reported

points.text: One video discusses which Gameweek to use a Free Hit chip in, but compares several options without picking a single answer.
points.label: reported

points.text: A recent video says the creator has already made a transfer for Gameweek 11. Viewers can use that as a sign of what one person is doing, not a rule.
points.label: opinion

points.text: For a 15-minute weekly routine, pick one video or none, make your transfers once, and avoid chasing every hot take.
points.label: ai interpretation

differences.text: Videos disagree on timing. Some frame the talk as ahead of Gameweek 11, while one says Gameweek 10 in its description.
